en.headline: The Big Picnic returns to Discovery Bay beach after seven-year break
en.dek: The community music festival runs from 11 a.m. to 10 p.m. today at Tai Pak Beach, with more than 20 bands, food stalls and a kids zone.
body: The Big Picnic returns to Tai Pak Beach in Discovery Bay today after a seven-year absence, organisers said.
The day-long event runs from 11 a.m. to 10 p.m. and features more than 20 bands performing across two stages, along with food vendors, beach bars and a Handmade Hong Kong market of local makers.

Families can use a dedicated kids zone that includes football activities. Ticket prices on the day start from HK$288 for adults, with lower rates for youth and domestic helpers, and free entry for children under five, according to the organisers.
Visitors can reach Discovery Bay by ferry from Central Pier 3 or by bus from Tung Chung. The organisers said the festival last took place in 2019.

zh.headline: The Big Picnic時隔七年重返愉景灣大白灣沙灘
zh.dek: 社區音樂節今日上午十一時至晚上十時於大白灣舉行，有逾二十支樂隊、美食攤檔及兒童專區。
body: 主辦單位表示，The Big Picnic時隔七年今日重返愉景灣大白灣沙灘。
活動由上午十一時至晚上十時舉行，逾二十支樂隊於兩個舞台演出，現場設有美食攤檔、沙灘酒吧，以及展示本地創作者的Handmade Hong Kong市集。
家庭遊客可使用兒童專區，包括足球主題活動。主辦單位指，現場門票成人由288元起，青少年及外傭有較低票價，五歲以下兒童免費。
市民可從中環三號碼頭乘渡輪，或從東涌乘巴士前往愉景灣。主辦單位稱，上一次舉辦是在二○一九年。
